name: Waiheʻe Ridge Trail
where: West Maui Forest Reserve, top of Maluhia Road off Kahekili Hwy, Maui
blurb: A state trail up Kanoa Ridge on windward West Maui, past a waterfall overlook and a view down Waiheʻe Valley, to the picnic table on Lanilili.
status: Open (DLNR Nā Ala Hele, Nov 2026); access-road gate 7 am–7 pm, small lot fills early, deep mud and summit clouds are common.
